# Zero Block Contact

A responsive contact block showing email, phone, physical location details alongside a direct inquiry message form.

## Properties

- **Section Title (`title`)**: Main contact header.
- **Section Subtitle (`lead`)**: Sub-headline copy.
- **Email Contact (`email`)**: Email address.
- **Phone Contact (`phone`)**: Phone number.
- **Physical Address (`address`)**: Postal address string.
- **Layout Display (`layout`)**:
  - `layout-1`: Split Columns (Details left, Inquiry form right)
  - `layout-2`: Centered Details Panel (Direct quick-contact cards)
- **Theme Mode (`themeStyle`)**: `light` / `dark`
